COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No.56 of 2025 
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, learned DAG along with Mr. 
S.C. Dumka, learned AGA and Mr. Pramod Tiwari, 
learned Brief Holder (appeared through V.C.) for the 
State.
2. This criminal jail appeal filed by the appellant is 
received through Superintendent, District Jail 
Haridwar.
3. As per Office report, there is delay of 25 days’ in 
filing the appeal. Since the appeal is filed through Jail 
by the appellant, therefore, the delay is not seriously 
opposed by learned State Counsel.
4. Accordingly, the delay in filing the criminal jail 
appeal is condoned. 
5. This criminal jail appeal is directed against the 
judgment and order dated 18.07.2025 passed by 
Additional Sessions Judge/FTSC, District Haridwar in 
Special Sessions Trial No.160 of 2022, State vs. 
Jitendra @ Kaku, whereby the appellant was convicted 
under Sections 377 r/w Section 511 IPC and sentenced 
to undergo 05 years’ R.I. with fine of Rs.20,000/- with 
default stipulation of 03 months’ additional simple 
imprisonment under Section 377/511 IPC and under 
Section 10 of the POCSO Act, 2012, appellant was 
sentenced to undergo 05 years’ R.I. with fine of 
Rs.20,000/- with default stipulation of three months’ 
additional simple imprisonment. Both the sentences  2
were directed to run concurrently.
6. Admit.
7. Sent for trial court record.
8. List on 24.11.2025.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
17.10.2025 AK
